name: MCP: connecting AI to tools and data

slides.title: Coming soon: MCP
slides.summary: The Model Context Protocol is an open standard for plugging tools and data into AI apps. This chapter is on its way.
body: MCP (the Model Context Protocol) is an open standard, introduced by Anthropic in November 2024, that lets any AI app connect to tools and data through one common plug, instead of a custom integration for each pair.
